data.name: Wither (Su)
data.description: A penanggalen's entrails drip with a foul bile that blisters and weakens living flesh. Any creature that is damaged by a penanggalen's Slam attack must succeed at a Fortitude save or take 1d4 Dexterity and 1d4 Charisma damage.
